name: Employee
description: Central data model containing employee demographics, contact information, employment details, and onboarding status throughout the lifecycle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Employee's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Employee's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for communication

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Official employment start date

fields.name: jobTitle
fields.description: Current job title or position

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department or team assignment

fields.name: onboardingStatus
fields.description: Current onboarding workflow stage (e.g., pending, in-progress, completed)

name: User
description: Store user accounts with role-based access control information for authentication and authorization

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user account

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address used for authentication and communication

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role for access control (HR Admin, IT Admin, Manager, Employee)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Account status indicating if user can access the system

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to associated Employee record

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last successful login

relationships.description: Links user account to employee profile

constraints.email: Must be valid email format and unique
constraints.role: Must be one of: HR Admin, IT Admin, Manager, Employee

name: Document
description: Manages employee onboarding documents with metadata, file references, and verification status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this document

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of document (ID_PROOF, TAX_FORM, SIGNED_AGREEMENT, AUTHORIZATION_FORM)

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: Storage path or URL reference to the uploaded document file

fields.name: verificationStatus
fields.description: Current verification status (PENDING, VERIFIED, REJECTED)

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version number for document tracking

relationships.description: Each document belongs to one employee

name: ApprovalRecord
description: Store approval decisions and workflow progression data for employee onboarding processes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being onboarded

fields.name: approverId
fields.description: Reference to the user who made the approval decision

fields.name: status
fields.description: Approval decision status (pending, approved, rejected, delegated, escalated)

fields.name: workflowStage
fields.description: Current stage in the approval workflow (e.g., manager_review, hr_review, it_setup)

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Approver comments or rejection reasons

fields.name: decisionDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the approval decision was made

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the approval record was created

relationships.description: Links approval record to the employee being onboarded
Links approval record to the approver user

indexes.description: Optimize queries for approval records by employee and workflow stage
Optimize queries for pending approvals and time-based reports

name: WorkflowStage
description: Represents individual workflow stages with status tracking, dependencies, and execution criteria for employee onboarding processes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the workflow stage

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee undergoing onboarding

fields.name: stageName
fields.description: Name of the workflow stage (e.g., 'Document Submission', 'Manager Approval')

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current execution status: pending, in_progress, completed, failed, skipped

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.description: Array of stage IDs that must complete before this stage can start

fields.name: allowParallelExecution
fields.description: Whether this stage can execute in parallel with other stages

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the stage was completed

fields.name: assignedTo
fields.description: User ID responsible for completing this stage

relationships.description: Each workflow stage belongs to one employee
Each stage may be assigned to a user

indexes.description: Optimize queries for employee workflow progress
Optimize queries for user task lists

name: TaxInformation
description: Store employee tax-related information and form data including W-4/W-9 details, withholding allowances, and filing status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for tax information record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee this tax information belongs to

fields.name: formType
fields.description: Type of tax form (W-4, W-9)

fields.name: filingStatus
fields.description: Tax filing status (Single, Married Filing Jointly, Head of Household, etc.)

fields.name: withholdingAllowances
fields.description: Number of withholding allowances claimed

fields.name: additionalWithholding
fields.description: Additional amount to withhold per pay period

fields.name: taxClassification
fields.description: Tax classification for W-9 (Individual, C Corporation, S Corporation, Partnership, etc.)

fields.name: encryptedSSN
fields.description: Encrypted Social Security Number or Tax ID

relationships.description: Each tax information record belongs to one employee
Tax information can have multiple associated documents (scanned forms, supporting documents)

name: DirectDepositInfo
description: Securely stores employee banking and direct deposit details with encryption at rest for financial data protection

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the direct deposit record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this direct deposit information

fields.name: encryptedAccountNumber
fields.description: Encrypted bank account number for secure storage

fields.name: encryptedRoutingNumber
fields.description: Encrypted bank routing number for secure storage

fields.name: accountType
fields.description: Type of bank account (checking, savings)

fields.name: depositAllocationPercentage
fields.description: Percentage of paycheck to deposit into this account (0-100)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this direct deposit account is currently active

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the bank account was verified

relationships.description: Each direct deposit record belongs to one employee

constraints.encryption: AES-256 encryption required for accountNumber and routingNumber fields
constraints.accessControl: Restricted to HR administrators and payroll processors only

name: EmergencyContact
description: Store emergency contact information for employees with priority ordering and relationship tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the emergency contact record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee this contact belongs to

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the emergency contact person

fields.name: relationship
fields.description: Relationship to employee (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling, friend)

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Primary contact phone number

fields.name: alternatePhoneNumber
fields.description: Secondary contact phone number

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Contact priority order (1 = primary contact, 2 = secondary, etc.)

fields.name: address
fields.description: Physical address of the emergency contact

relationships.description: Each emergency contact belongs to one employee

name: ThirtyDayReview
description: Store 30-day review feedback and assessment data for new employees

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the 30-day review

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being reviewed

fields.name: reviewerId
fields.description: Reference to the manager/user conducting the review

fields.name: reviewDate
fields.description: Date when the review was conducted

fields.name: overallRating
fields.description: Overall performance rating (e.g., 1-5 scale)

fields.name: managerFeedback
fields.description: Narrative feedback including observations, achievements, and areas for improvement

fields.name: status
fields.description: Review status (draft, completed, acknowledged)

constraints.status: Must be one of: draft, completed, acknowledged

name: ITSetupTask
description: Tracks IT provisioning tasks including account creation, equipment assignment, access provisioning, and software installations for new employees

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the IT setup task

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving IT setup

fields.name: taskType
fields.description: Type of IT task (account_creation, equipment_assignment, access_provisioning, software_installation)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the task (pending, in_progress, completed, blocked)

fields.name: assignedToUserId
fields.description: Reference to the IT admin user assigned to complete this task

fields.name: equipmentDetails
fields.description: Details of equipment assigned or software installed (JSON string or text)

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Target completion date for the IT setup task

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the task was completed

relationships.description: Each IT setup task belongs to one employee
Each task is assigned to one IT admin user

name: NotificationLog
description: Maintains audit trail of all system notifications sent during employee onboarding process

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification log entry

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee associated with this notification

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the notification recipient

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., welcome_email, document_reminder, approval_request, task_assignment)

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Current delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, bounced)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts made

fields.name: referenceId
fields.description: Reference to related entity (Document ID, Approval ID, Task ID, etc.)

relationships.description: Links notification to the associated employee

name: AuditLog
description: Comprehensive audit trail for all system activities and data changes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user who performed the action

fields.name: action
fields.description: Type of action performed (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, ACCESS, LOGIN, LOGOUT, APPROVE, REJECT)

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (Employee, Document, ApprovalRecord, etc.)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the specific entity that was affected

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before/after values of modified fields

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the action was performed

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

relationships.description: Links audit entry to the user who performed the action

name: VerificationRecord
description: Tracks document and information verification activities across workflow stages with audit trail of verification attempts, outcomes, and verifier details

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the verification record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being verified

fields.name: workflowStageId
fields.description: Reference to the workflow stage where verification occurs

fields.name: documentId
fields.description: Reference to the document or information being verified (nullable for non-document verifications)

fields.name: verifierId
fields.description: Reference to the user who performed the verification

fields.name: verificationStatus
fields.description: Outcome of verification: pending, approved, rejected, requires_resubmission

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when verification was completed (null if still pending)

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Verifier notes, rejection reasons, or additional context

relationships.description: Links verification to specific workflow stage
Links verification to specific document if applicable
Links verification to the verifier user

indexes.description: Optimize queries for employee verification history by stage
Optimize queries for verification timeline analysis

verificationStatus.description: Restricts status to valid verification outcomes

name: BackgroundCheck
description: Track background check authorization and results for employee onboarding compliance

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the background check record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being screened

fields.name: consentDate
fields.description: Date when employee provided consent for background check

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status: pending, submitted, in_progress, completed, failed

fields.name: providerName
fields.description: Name of external background check provider

fields.name: result
fields.description: Check result: clear, conditional, adverse, null if incomplete

fields.name: completedDate
fields.description: Date when background check was completed

fields.name: externalReferenceId
fields.description: Provider's reference ID for tracking with external system

relationships.description: Each background check belongs to one employee
